Application Data.NAME: CleanSweep Vacuum Sales & Service
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: CleanSweep Vacuum Sales & Service specializes in the sale and servicing of vacuum cleaners, providing customers with high-quality products and reliable repair services. Our operations include retail sales of various vacuum cleaner brands and models, along with comprehensive maintenance and repair services. We ensure that all repairs utilize compatible parts to maintain safety and performance standards. Additionally, we offer training sessions for customers on the proper use and maintenance of vacuum cleaners, emphasizing customer satisfaction and safety.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a customer reported an injury resulting from a faulty vacuum cleaner that was sold by our store, leading to a liability claim totaling $5,000. The claim is currently under review, and we are working with our legal team to address the matter appropriately. The vacuum cleaner involved in the incident was sourced from a manufacturer with a known history of quality issues, which has raised concerns about potential compatibility with repairs.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security patrols during business hours, installation of perimeter fencing, and monitoring of surveillance cameras to ensure the safety of the premises and protection of inventory.

Preferred Optional Coverages
• Cyber Liability: To protect against data breaches, cyber extortion, and liability arising
from compromised customer information, especially critical for online sales operations.
• Product Liability: Essential for coverage of bodily injury or property damage claims re-
